title: Existence of successor transformation
statement: For abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], effaceable cohomological delta-functor F [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor], any delta-functor G, degree n and natural transformation t:F^n→G^n, there exists a natural transformation t′:F^{n+1}→G^{n+1} commuting with connecting maps for every short exact sequence.

source.place: Lemma Tag 010T (lemma-efface-implies-universal), with its proof (induction on n through the cokernel description F^{n+1}(A)=Coker(F^n(B)->F^n(C)); the verification that t^{n+1} is a natural transformation is 'omitted' in Stacks and must be written out at the split)

proof.text: Construct each candidate by the cokernel property of the effacing connecting epimorphism. Compare candidates along morphisms using naturality and epi cancellation. Apply the comparison span to prove independence and naturality, and the pushout lemma to prove compatibility for every sequence. These are steps 1–9 of the parent proof, now implemented in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 010T, induction construction; the omitted independence, naturality and connecting-map compatibility verifications are supplied by J2 using the parent node direct-sum and pushout arguments.

lean.statement: theorem effaceable_deltaFunctor_successor {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A] [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B] (F : CohomologicalDeltaFunctor A B) (hF : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (X : A), ∃ (Y : A) (u : X ⟶ Y), Mono u ∧ (F.F n).map u = 0) (G : CohomologicalDeltaFunctor A B) (n : ℕ) (t : F.F n ⟶ G.F n) : ∃ t' : F.F (n + 1) ⟶ G.F (n + 1), ∀ (S : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact), F.delta S hS n ≫ t'.app S.X₁ = t.app S.X₃ ≫ G.delta S hS n
